claim: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre runs 50-minute shows with multiple daily slots (5:20pm, 6:30pm, 8:00pm peak times) at 57B Dinh Tien Hoang, 50m from Hoan Kiem Lake.
quote: The theatre runs 7 shows daily, Monday through Saturday, and 8 shows on Sundays... Each show runs 50 minutes across 18 scenes performed continuously without intermission. The Saturday 5:20 PM, 6:30 PM, and 8:00 PM shows reach full capacity.

claim: Tickets at Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre cost 100,000 VND standard / 150,000 VND economy / 200,000 VND VIP, bookable directly online with international cards.
quote: Standard 100,000 VND; Economy 150,000 VND; VIP 200,000 VND. Online booking via the official site is the lowest-cost channel; international cards accepted; e-ticket issued instantly.

claim: Hanoi in June averages 27-33°C daytime highs falling to 26°C at night, with daily highs ranging 88-103°F.
quote: Daily high temperatures range from 88° to 103°, with overnight lows between 77° and 85°.

claim: June is wet monsoon in Hanoi with ~15 rainy days and ~242mm rainfall, 20% wetter than May.
quote: There are usually 15 days with some rain in Hanoi in June and the average monthly rainfall is 242mm... In June, the accumulation of rainfall is, on average, 20% higher than in May.

claim: Vietnam's e-Visa is now available to all nationalities for up to 90 days single- or multiple-entry, with 83 eligible border gates as of 2026.
quote: Vietnam's electronic visa (e-Visa) system has been expanded to all countries and territories, with validity extended from 30 days to up to 90 days, offering both single-entry and multiple-entry options.

claim: Vietnam added 12 European countries (Belgium, Netherlands, Switzerland, Poland, Czech Republic, etc.) to its 45-day visa-exemption list in August 2025, effective through August 2028.
quote: Resolution No. 229/NQ-CP grants visa exemptions to citizens of 12 additional European countries (Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Hungary, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, and Slovenia) for a temporary stay of up to 45 days, effective from 15 August 2025 to 14 August 2028.

claim: Grab from Noi Bai (HAN) to the Old Quarter typically costs 200,000-300,000 VND for a 4-seater; traditional metered taxis run 400,000-600,000 VND.
quote: Fares typically run 200,000–300,000 VND for a 4-seater to the Old Quarter... A taxi from Hanoi Airport to the city center usually costs between 400,000 and 600,000 VND.

claim: Xanh SM electric taxis (VinFast, bright cyan) from HAN airport start at 240,000 VND for a 4-seater; EVs have overtaken combustion vehicles in Hanoi's ride-hailing sector in 2026.
quote: The fare for a 4-seater car for this Hanoi taxi from the airport starts at VND 240,000... In 2026, electric vehicles (EVs) have officially overtaken traditional combustion engines in Hanoi's ride-hailing sector.

claim: Binh Minh Jazz Club at 1 Trang Tien Street hosts live jazz nightly from 9-11pm, often featuring saxophonist-owner Quyen Van Minh with his students.
quote: Live Jazz begins every night at 9PM... Quyen Van Minh... performs nearly every night at his Jazz club with his students who are to become the next generation of jazz musicians in Vietnam.

claim: Top of Hanoi sits on the 65th floor of Lotte Hotel Hanoi as the city's highest rooftop bar, with 360-degree views and brasserie-style food.
quote: Top of Hanoi is Hanoi's highest rooftop bar, located on the 65th floor of the Lotte Hotel Hanoi, offering stunning 360-degree views of the entire city.

claim: Twilight Sky Bar offers 270-degree views over the lake from an 8th-floor terrace near Hoan Kiem.
quote: Eight floors up, the rooftop is close enough to feel the pulse of the city streets, but high enough to give a fantastic 270-degree view of the city skyline and amazing vistas over the nearby lake.

claim: Hanoi's weekend night market runs Friday-Sunday evenings 6-11pm, stretching from Hang Dao Street near Hoan Kiem Lake to Dong Xuan Market.
quote: The Hanoi Night Market takes place every Friday to Sunday evening, typically from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM. It stretches from Hang Dao Street near Hoan Kiem Lake to Dong Xuan Market.

claim: Bia Hoi Corner — where Ta Hien meets Luong Ngoc Quyen — wakes up at 6pm and peaks 8:30-10:30pm with backpackers, locals and expats sharing tiny stools over cheap fresh-brewed beer.
quote: Ta Hien wakes up at 6 PM and does not slow down easily. Tiny stools spill onto the road, cold bia hoi flows at throwaway prices... Peak time hits between 8:30 and 10:30 PM.

claim: Hanoi's shoe-shine scam can produce bills 10-20x the legitimate 20,000-30,000 VND rate; the doughnut/fruit-basket ladies in the Old Quarter pressure tourists into overpaying after a 'free' sample.
quote: Shoe shine scams can result in bills 10–20x higher than the legitimate price. A legitimate shoe shine in Hanoi costs 20,000–30,000 VND... The seller will stop and ask if you'd like to try one for free, and when you say yes and taste one, the vendor will talk you into buying a small bag of donuts.

claim: Cyclo rides should be priced upfront in VND (legitimate Old Quarter loop ~100,000-150,000 VND); fake taxis and rigged meters remain the top risk at Noi Bai — use Grab, Be, Mai Linh, or Taxi Group only.
quote: Cyclo price ambushes can turn a charming ride into a $50 surprise if you don't negotiate upfront... Fake taxis and rigged meters are the #1 threat at Noi Bai Airport... only use reputable brands: Hanoi Taxi, Mai Linh, or Taxi Group.

claim: Tipping in Vietnam is optional but appreciated; tip in VND (20,000-200,000 VND depending on service), with private drivers welcoming 50,000-100,000 VND per day.
quote: Always tip in Vietnamese Dong (VND), not US dollars... How much: 20,000-200,000 VND ($0.85-$8.50) depending on service... Private drivers also welcome tips, with 50,000–100,000 VND per day considered fair for good service.

claim: VND notes are polymer 10,000-500,000 denominations; international cards work at 20,000+ ATMs nationwide, with per-transaction limits of 2-3 million VND at local banks and 5-10 million VND at international banks.
quote: International cards such as Visa are accepted at more than 20,000 ATMs nationwide... Withdrawal limits per transaction range between 2 million VND... and 3 million VND with local bank ATMs; and between 5 million VND to 10 million VND with international bank ATMs.

claim: Lune Production's 'Lang Toi - My Village' bamboo-circus show runs 2-4 days a week at the Hanoi Opera House and Tuong Theatre with tickets at 700,000 / 1,150,000 / 1,600,000 VND.
quote: My Village show is performed from 2 to 4 days per week in Hanoi Opera House and Hanoi Vietnam Tuong Theatre... 700,000 VND for AAH! Ticket, 1,150,000 VND for OOH! Ticket and 1,600,000 VND for WOW! Ticket.

claim: To cross Hanoi streets safely: walk slowly and steadily, do not stop or run, maintain eye contact with motorbike drivers, and trust the flow to part around you.
quote: Walk slowly and steadily. Do not stop suddenly, do not run, and do not wait for a complete gap in traffic that will never come. Motorbike drivers are experts at navigating around pedestrians — they expect you to keep moving at a predictable pace.
